crossRefs.note: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them…
The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.
All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces…
saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.
and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things…
One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives…
Yahweh will reign forever and ever.”
For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.
Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever…

translations.web: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,
translations.bsb: And whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne, who lives forever and ever,
translations.kjv: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,
translations.asv: And when the living creatures shall give glory and honor and thanks to him that sitteth on the throne, to him that liveth for ever and ever,
